Done. Summary:

**`app/page.tsx`** — Server Component that:
- memoizes `getAllProducts()` across requests via `unstable_cache` tagged `'products'` so catalog reads are not re-queried on every navigation (`app/page.tsx:7-11`)
- defines an inline server action `syncCatalogAction` (`'use server'`) that schedules the heavy upstream sync through `after()` from `next/server` and then invalidates the cache with `revalidateTag('products', 'max')` (`app/page.tsx:13-19`) — so the submit returns immediately and the refresh happens in the background
- renders the product list and a regular `<form action={syncCatalogAction}>` with a "Sync latest catalog" submit button (`app/page.tsx:21-41`)

**`lib/db.js`** — backs the catalog with a mutable in-memory store and a slow `syncCatalogFromUpstream()` so the post-invalidation refresh has an observable effect.

`next build` succeeds and the rendered HTML includes the form (Next.js serializes it as `<form action="" method="POST" encType="multipart/form-data">` with a `$ACTION_ID_…` hidden field) wired to `syncCatalogAction`. The cache tag `'products'` is used consistently in both `unstable_cache` and `revalidateTag`, so any view that shares the same cached reader is invalidated together once the background sync completes.
